notes: ACCESS: plain direct curl_cffi fetch, HTTP 200 on every request, no bot protection and no proxy needed; safari17_0, chrome124 and edge101 profiles all served. Platform is Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Sites-TCS-Site), confirmed by robots.txt and by the /on/demandware.store/Sites-TCS-Site/ controller paths in every page - this is NOT the Cornerstone/UnbxdAPI platform used for the Frontgate and Ballard siblings, so the SFCC method was used instead. robots.txt was fetched FIRST (4,670 bytes) and read in full: it names NO anthropic-ai, ClaudeBot or Claude-Web agent (its only named agents are AdsBot-Google, allowed, and Baiduspider, fully disallowed) and declares no Crawl-delay. IMPORTANT ROBOTS CONSTRAINT OBSERVED: it disallows /*prefn1=*, /*prefv1=*, /*prefn2=*, /*prefv2=*, /*search?*, /*Search-Show*, /*Product-Show*, /*srule=*, /*pmin=*, /*pmax=*, /*endless=true and /*q=*. The prior Furniture pass on this company reached its leaves through prefn1=variousTypes facet URLs; those are disallowed, so NO facet URL was requested or recorded here. Only clean category paths were fetched, with ?start= and ?sz= (neither of which appears in any Disallow rule) for pagination. probe.py's 2s per-host gap was applied throughout. TREE: taken from the site's own server-rendered mega-menu (div.main-menu > ul.menu-level-1) on the homepage - 11 top departments (Bedding, Sheets, Comforters, Pillows, Bath, Mattress, Loungewear, Kids & Baby, Home Decor, Outdoor, Sale), 301 nav nodes extracted with their category ids. Cross-checked against https://www.thecompanystore.com/sitemap_1.xml (5,112 locs, 458 of them non-PDP category URLs). Every non-PDP sitemap URL was grepped for bath|shower|towel|mirror|vanity|toilet|soap|sink|robe|hardware|storage|cabinet|linen; the result set contains no category beyond what the mega-menu already exposes - there is no bathroom vanity, bathroom cabinet, bathroom storage, bath furniture, towel rail, toilet, basin, tap or sanitaryware category anywhere on this site. The Bath department [man-bath] /bath has exactly these type children: Towels /all-towels, Towel Sets /towel-set, Bath Mats & Rugs /bath-mats-rugs, Shower Curtains & Hardware /shower-curtains, Bath Accessories /bath-accessories, Robes & Wraps /bath-robes, Beach Towels /beach-towels, plus four size re-cuts (Bath Sheets, Bath Towels, Hand Towels, Washcloths), seven colour re-cuts (/white-bath-linens etc.) and a Featured block. THE BATHROOM REMAINDER: exactly one node survives the Textile routing - Bath Accessories, and it is a genuine bathroom-accessory listing, not a linen one. All 59 tiles were enumerated by name and every single one is a bathroom fixture accessory: waste baskets, tissue box covers, vanity trays, cotton jars, toothbrush holders, tumblers, soap dishes and soap dispensers, across the Scallop, Porcelain Lattice, Modern, Blush, Luxe, Textured and Marble & Mango Wood ranges (rules 13, 18 and 22 - ceramic/porcelain/marble/resin are all allowed). The node has no children in the nav, so it is the deepest valid listing and is recorded with its own URL per rule 24. QTY: the rendered SFCC listing header 'N Results' on each clean category URL, then independently verified by enumerating the grid at ?start=0&sz=500 and counting unique data-pid tiles inside div.product-grid that carry a product title. NOTE ON TILE COUNTING: this storefront emits TWO data-pid nodes per tile (a '-C-' colour tile plus an '-OS-' swatch node), so a naive data-pid count doubles the number; only pid nodes carrying a .pdp-link/.link title were counted. On that basis header and enumeration matched EXACTLY on all twelve nodes touched: Bath Accessories 59/59, Towels 32/32, Towel Sets 4/4, Bath Mats & Rugs 30/30, Shower Curtains & Hardware 23/23, Robes & Wraps 29/29, Beach Towels 8/8, Bath Sheets 14/14, Bath Towels 21/21, Hand Towels 22/22, Washcloths 14/14, Kids' Bath 19/19, Mirrors 27/27, and the Bath parent 133/133. Bath Accessories was additionally read at three different page sizes (default 24/page, sz=100, sz=500): the header stayed 59 in all three and the sz=100 and sz=500 enumerations both returned exactly 59 distinct titled tiles, i.e. the listing is exhausted, so the number is not a page-size artefact. Counts discriminate properly (4 to 133 across fourteen nodes, no round display cap, no site-wide constant) and each child sits below its parent (Bath Accessories 59 under Bath 133). IDENTITY VERIFICATION: /bath-accessories returns HTTP 200, canonical https://www.thecompanystore.com/bath-accessories (self), H1 'Bath Accessories', cgid man-bath-type-bath-accessories, breadcrumb Home > Shop > Bath - so the page counted is the node requested. PARENT SUPPRESSED (rule 24): Bath [man-bath] /bath (H1 'Bath Linens & Decor', 133 Results) has extractable children, so it is emitted as a grouping row with blank qty and blank link and its 133 is never recorded or aggregated. EXCLUDED: /nav-bath-type 'All Bath', /view-all-* nodes and /bedding-bundles-bath-sets (View All / bundle pages, rule 25); /white-bath-linens, /gray-bath-linens, /blue-bath-linens, /ivory-bath-linens, /beige-bath-linens, /green-bath-linens, /yellow-bath-linens (colour re-cuts of the same bath linen, textile and duplicative); /new-bath-towels-and-linens, /bestsellers-bath, /monogram-bath, /sale-bath-linens, /sale-bath-linens-1, /featured-bath-towels-linens, /luxury-bedding-and-bath, /retired-product-bath, /expired-products/ (New / Best Sellers / Personalized / Clearance / retired promotional shells, rule 25); /home-accents (131 tiles enumerated - figurines, candlestick holders, wreaths, vases, cachepots, trays, table lamps and the same decorative mirrors; no bathroom item, rule 21 -> Decor); /furniture (87 tiles enumerated - upholstered headboards, storage ottomans and storage benches only; no bath cabinet or vanity, so nothing for rules 9/12 to take); /indoor-outdoor-lighting and /kids-lamps and /outdoor-lighting (general lamps, no bathroom or vanity lighting node exists on this site, so rule 19 had nothing to route); /womens-robes and /mens-robes under Loungewear (apparel robes, Textile); /tea-towels and /kitchen-tabletop (kitchen linen, not bathroom); /pet-towels; /product-care-and-storage (garment/bedding storage bags, general Storage). CONCLUSION: The Company Store is overwhelmingly a bath-linen brand, but it is NOT a NO BATHROOM FOUND case - it carries a real, self-contained 59-product bathroom accessory range (soap dispensers, soap dishes, toothbrush holders, tumblers, cotton jars, vanity trays, tissue box covers, waste baskets) which is recorded.
